resources.string:
Samsung Health Bridge reads only steps, exercise sessions, sleep, weight, and body fat that you explicitly allow in Health Connect. It writes daily summaries and, only when you press the diagnostic export button, raw records and available aggregates directly to one Google Sheet in your Google Drive. It never reads exercise routes.

Health values are not sent to any server operated by this app, are not written to production logs, and are not stored permanently inside the app. The app stores only the spreadsheet identifier, the last synchronization time, and a non-health status message.

You can revoke Health Connect permissions or Google Drive access at any time.
